parentWaterMask.policy: Raw parent water/land classification preserved at every refinement node.

source.policy: Original native terrain facets in the core; 10m outer transition split on original parent triangle boundaries. Parent water mask retained. Source building geometry and elevations unchanged.

parentHoleFill.policy: No material parent hole; sub-square-millimetre projected slivers are numerical overlay residue.

source.policy: Original source facets with bounded parent-edge transition; no AI geometry.

protectedParentProjection.clearancePolicy: The complete current parent surface is retained under the unrelated neighbour. At every source facet that projects into this tiny boundary overlap, the unchanged government surface is at least 8.5m above that parent terrain.
protectedParentProjection.policy: Current rendered parent terrain is retained only beneath the unresolved neighbouring source form; no building geometry or elevation changes.
